claimed_title: Executive Order 5420—Revocation of Withdrawal of Public Lands for Resurvey
text:
Executive Order 5420. August 5, 1930
Executive Order
Revocation of Withdrawal of Public Lands for Resurvey
Colorado
It is hereby ordered that Executive Order No. 4322, dated October 15, 1925,
vrithdrawing the public lands in T. 49 N., R. 12 E., New Mexico principal meridian,
Colorado, pending a resurvey, be, and the same is hereby, revoked.
And it is hereby ordered, pursuant to Public Resolution No. 85, 71st Congress,
approved June 12, 1930, and subject to vaUd rights, that the above-described lands,
if otherwise subject to disposition, shall be opened, under the terms and conditions
of such resolution and the regulations issued thereunder, to entry under the home-
stead or desert land laws only for a period of 91 days, beginning with the date of the
official filing of the plat of resurvey, by qualified ex-service men for whose service
recognition is granted by the resolution, and thereafter to appropriation by the
general public under any public land law appUcable thereto.
Subsequent to the date hereof and prior to the date of restoration to general
disposition as herein provided, no right may be acquired to the released lands by
settlement in advance of entry or otherwise, except strictly in accordance herewith.
HERBERT HOOVER
The White House,
August 5, 1930.
[No. 5420]
